business_problem: Housing.com needed a better way to support real estate pricing intelligence, personalization, and fraud-aware demand forecasting because rapidly growing property, buyer, and renter data stayed stuck in silos, which weakened pricing accuracy, personalization, and fraud detection.
solution_summary: Housing.com uses Databricks Data + AI Platform to support real estate pricing intelligence, personalization, and fraud-aware demand forecasting. The implementation replaced a legacy state where rapidly growing property, buyer, and renter data stayed stuck in silos, which weakened pricing accuracy, personalization, and fraud detection. Property listings and buyer and renter behavior move through production data pipelines and land in Delta Lake, giving teams one trusted data foundation. Unity Catalog and Delta Sharing governs access, lineage, and compliance across sensitive datasets. MLflow operationalizes models, agents, and analytics that deliver pricing predictions and demand forecasts. Housing.
business_outcome: Housing.com improved real estate pricing intelligence, personalization, and fraud-aware demand forecasting with measurable results including 10%–15%, 20% reduction in time to insight, and 50% increase in team productivity, while giving teams a faster path from governed data to production decisions.
architecture_clues: Centralized governance, lineage, and access controls are enforced through Unity Catalog.
Delta Lake provides the shared storage layer for curated lakehouse datasets.
Operational AI workflows are deployed directly beside governed data and analytics assets.
evidence_quotes: The cost of storage wasn’t the problem — the cost of computing was way more, compared to other services. So, in moving away from our data warehouse, we actually saved 50% in total costs.
It has been much easier on our teams because now, there’s only one definition of the data, and it’s also not getting hidden in different silos.
